# nyc42.lol — what's on in New York City

> Listings and news for New York City. Every entry names the source it came from and the day it was checked against it. Independent publication: not a government outlet, not a ticket seller, not affiliated with any venue.

How this site works, in five rules:

- **Every fact names where it came from, and when we last looked.** The source prints as text, never as a live link.
- **Nothing is listed on a date we could not confirm.** If the organiser said "early November" and nothing more, no invented day appears here — the missing day appears instead.
- **What's on, not what went wrong.** No politics, no crime, no tragedy.
- **We pick the best, and say why.** Picking out the best of something is the job; running a named business down is not.
- **A page exists when there is something to put on it.** No empty templates waiting for content.

## What a reader finds here

- [Events](https://nyc42.lol/events/): events on dates confirmed with the organiser, with times, prices and running order where the organiser published them.
- [News](https://nyc42.lol/news/): what changed in the city. Long pieces carrying the whole calendar or the whole figure, not a wire paragraph.
- [About](https://nyc42.lol/about/): the rules above, written out at length.

## Where the facts come from

The organiser, or the publication that reported it: Time Out New York, Gothamist, The City, The New York Times, and the organisers themselves. Each entry prints that name and the date it was verified. Venue coordinates are geocoded once and stored in the data; where the geocoder returns the wrong place, the entry publishes without a map rather than with a wrong one.

Where a voice from Reddit appears in the text, it is a direct quotation from a public post, attributed to the subreddit rather than to the person.

What has not been announced is said to be unannounced. A closing date nobody has given, a theme not yet confirmed and a running order still to come are three things this site names rather than fills in.

## Events

- [Village Halloween Parade 2026](https://nyc42.lol/events/village-halloween-parade-2026/): The 53rd parade goes up Sixth Avenue at 7pm on Saturday 31 October. Watching is free, joining in is free if you are in costume, and it happens rain or shine.
- [Open House New York Weekend 2026](https://nyc42.lol/events/open-house-new-york-weekend-2026/): Three hundred buildings across the five boroughs open for one weekend, 16–18 October. OHNY has the lineup down for 25 September and tickets for 2 October.
- [New York Comic Con 2026](https://nyc42.lol/events/new-york-comic-con-2026/): Four days at the Javits Center, 8–11 October, for NYCC's twentieth anniversary — with a Coney Island theme and the panel schedule already published.
- [New York Film Festival 2026](https://nyc42.lol/events/new-york-film-festival-2026/): The 64th NYFF runs 25 September to 12 October: 32 films in the Main Slate, opening with James Gray's Paper Tiger and closing with Ava DuVernay's 14th, screening in all five boroughs.
- [Harry Potter at Broadway Week](https://nyc42.lol/events/broadway-week-harry-potter/): The two-for-one runs 8 to 20 September at the Lyric. It is the largest saving on the Broadway Week list, and the reason is the house rather than the play.
- [Hadestown at Broadway Week](https://nyc42.lol/events/broadway-week-hadestown/): Anaïs Mitchell's Orpheus and Eurydice takes the two-for-one from 8 to 20 September at the Walter Kerr. The one on the list most likely to be the best evening rather than the best deal.
- [Stranger Things at Broadway Week](https://nyc42.lol/events/broadway-week-stranger-things/): The First Shadow takes the two-for-one from 8 to 20 September at the Marquis. Recent, effects-heavy and in a big house — which is what makes the offer valuable and the seat allocation risky.
- [Six at Broadway Week](https://nyc42.lol/events/broadway-week-six/): Eighty minutes, no interval, Tudor England as a pop concert. On the two-for-one from 8 to 20 September at the Lena Horne — the cheapest way this fortnight to put two people in a Broadway theatre.
- [Oh Mary! at Broadway Week](https://nyc42.lol/events/broadway-week-oh-mary/): The comedy on the Broadway Week list, at the Lyceum from 8 to 20 September. In a house this small the offer buys proximity rather than merely a seat.
- [The Lion King at Broadway Week](https://nyc42.lol/events/broadway-week-the-lion-king/): On the two-for-one from 8 to 20 September at the Minskoff. One of the safest evenings in New York — and one of the three shows on the list where the offer is doing the least work.
- [Wicked at Broadway Week](https://nyc42.lol/events/broadway-week-wicked/): Two-for-one at the Gershwin from 8 to 20 September. A long-runner in Broadway's largest house — reliable, and reliably discounted the rest of the year too.
- [Chicago at Broadway Week](https://nyc42.lol/events/broadway-week-chicago/): The longest-running American musical on Broadway takes the two-for-one from 8 to 20 September at the Ambassador. A safe evening, and the offer's least necessary use.
- [NYC Broadway Week: two-for-one at 25 shows](https://nyc42.lol/events/broadway-week-fall-2026/): Two weeks of 2-for-1 Broadway tickets across 25 productions, from 8 to 20 September 2026. Tickets have been on sale since 18 August.

## News

- [The FDNY's museum is open again, two weeks before the 25th anniversary](https://nyc42.lol/news/fire-museum-reopens-after-two-years/): Closed since May 2024 over the structural integrity of its 1904 firehouse, the city's fire museum reopened on 20 August — days before 11 September 2026.
- [The city's first inhabitants get the room, and curate it themselves](https://nyc42.lol/news/lenape-legacies-at-the-museum-of-the-city/): The Museum of the City of New York opens a show organised with the Éenda-Lŭnaapeewáhkiing Collective, with more than 30 artists — and no past tense.
- [The Transit Museum turns 50 and parks its buses in Brooklyn Bridge Park](https://nyc42.lol/news/transit-museum-bus-festival-turns-fifty/): Saturday 19 September, 10am to 3:30pm, Brooklyn Bridge Park, free — vintage buses at street level in the year the museum reaches its fiftieth.
- [Broadway's autumn is 15 shows, and only four are musicals](https://nyc42.lol/news/broadway-autumn-is-a-play-season/): Eleven plays to four musicals, and eight of the fifteen are revivals. That ratio says more about the economics than any grosses report.
- [$350 billion to $4 trillion: the number that ended on 1 September](https://nyc42.lol/news/apple-from-350-billion-to-four-trillion/): Tim Cook handed Apple to John Ternus on 1 September. The run he closes out is the largest single-tenure value creation the market has recorded, and it is not repeatable.
- [Venice hands out a Lion; New York refuses to rank anything](https://nyc42.lol/news/venice-hands-out-a-lion-new-york-refuses-to-rank/): The 83rd Venice festival opens 2 September with a jury, a competition and a Golden Lion. NYFF opens 13 days later with none of the three, and that is a decision.
- [Broadway Week: which of the 25 is it for](https://nyc42.lol/news/broadway-week-which-shows-are-worth-it/): Twenty-five shows take the two-for-one from 8 to 20 September. They are not equally worth it, and the reason has less to do with the shows than with what each one costs the rest of the year.
- [The Brooklyn Museum sets out its autumn](https://nyc42.lol/news/brooklyn-museum-fall-2026/): Six new shows open in October: manga in the Great Hall, fifty European masterpieces from the Pearlman Collection, Hopi kachina dolls and an installation in the lobby about the Tuskegee Airmen.
- [Disney will sail from New York again in 2027](https://nyc42.lol/news/disney-cruises-return-to-nyc/): The Disney Wish returns to New York in autumn 2027 after four years away: seven sailings, five of them to Bermuda, one a foliage run to Boston, Saint John and Halifax. Booking opens 8 September.
- [Hudson foliage cruise tickets are on sale](https://nyc42.lol/news/hudson-river-foliage-cruises/): Circle Line has two foliage sailings this September: an eight-hour run to Bear Mountain on the 19th and 20th, and a four-hour trip toward Hook Mountain on the 26th and 27th. Last year sold out.
